# Card

Container that groups one subject: header (title, description), body and an actions footer.

`KenosUI.Card` · Layout

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Card>…</KenosUI.Card>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Card">…</x-import>
```

## Props (CardProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"elevated" \| "outline" \| "subtle"` | Default "outline". |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | Padding 16 / 24 / 28px. Default "md". |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `description` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `footer` | `React.ReactNode` | Actions row, usually Buttons. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  |

_Also accepts: Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "title">._
